Request Info 
 The Flir T840 infrared camera is designed to help electric utility and other thermography professionals comfortably survey equipment both indoors or outdoors and seek out signs of failure all day long. Thanks to an integrated eyepiece viewfinder and a bright 4-inch color LCD display, the T840 makes it easy to conduct inspections outside in bright, challenging light conditions. The 180° rotating lens platform and thoughtful ergonomic design helps users quickly diagnose failing components in hard-to-reach areas. Pair the T840 with a Flir FlexView™ dual field of view lens for the convenience to instantly switch from wide-area to telephoto scanning. A 6° telephoto lens option is also available to ensure accurate temperature measurement of small targets from farther distances. 
All Flir T-Series cameras now come with a free credit to attend a Flir Academy training session. 
 Fast, flexible, accurate – in any work environment 
 Safely and comfortably assess equipment 
 Scan large areas from a safe distance with 464 x 348 resolution, and reduce the strain of full-day inspections with the 180° rotating optical block 
 Make Critical Decisions Quickly 
 Get industry-leading image clarity from Flir Vision Processing™, MSX®, and UltraMax® to help you make the right call – fast 
 Designed to Make Your Work Easier 
 Get the most out of your workday with Flir Ignite automatic image uploading directly from the camera and rapid reporting features that help you organize findings in the field

iXX-Series
Thermal Imaging Camera for Condition Monitoring Inspections  
 Revolutionizing Thermal Inspections with App-Driven Intelligence 
The iXX-Series is a new class of app-powered thermal cameras designed to make inspections faster, easier, and more consistent—no matter the skill level of your team. From experienced thermographers to technicians new to thermal imaging, iXX cameras simplify every step of the process: capturing the right data, sharing it instantly, and turning it into actionable insights.
Built on the Flir Ace platform, the i34 and i64 work with apps developed by Flir, customers, and trusted third-party developers—so your camera can evolve with your inspection needs.  
 Build Your iXX 
 Watch the Video 
Advantages of Flir iXX-Series 
Our iXX-Series cameras are designed to transform thermal inspections into guided, connected, and fully integrated workflows. Powered by app-based intelligence, they help you capture consistent, high-quality data, share it instantly, and act on it—whether you’re troubleshooting a single asset or scaling inspections across multiple sites. Each thermal imaging camera in the iXX-Series combines intuitive design with powerful connectivity, making it easier for teams to detect faults, analyze data, and maintain safety standards. 
Condition Monitoring 
Improve asset reliability and avoid costly downtime with app-guided inspections that anyone can follow. The iXX-Series allows users to capture thermal images with accurate Delta T measurements, compare the data to baseline readings, and detect changes before they become failures. With automatic uploads to our Flir apps, Assetlink™ and Ignite™, you can track asset trends, generate work orders, and integrate results with your Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS)—without ever leaving the field. 
Electrical/Power Generation Inspection 
Reduce safety risks and improve decision-making with high-resolution thermal imaging, glove-friendly controls, and wide fields of view—ideal for inspecting energized equipment through IR windows. Use the Meterlink® app to capture load, voltage, and other electrical measurements alongside thermal data, giving you the complete context to prioritize repairs and prevent outages. Including a thermal camera in your maintenance routine allows you to identify potential issues early, extend equipment lifespan, and optimize operational efficiency. 
Building Inspection 
Streamline building diagnostics with workflows designed for HVAC performance checks, water damage assessment, and energy loss surveys. On-camera routing ensures consistency across inspections, while instant fault analysis helps you make confident recommendations on-site. Data is securely transferred to your cloud or asset management platform, so reports and insights are ready to share before you leave the job. Whether you’re detecting insulation gaps, identifying leaks, or evaluating energy performance, this thermal imaging camera delivers the precision and clarity needed to pinpoint issues quickly and accurately. 
Intelligent Condition Monitoring 
Improve asset reliability and avoid costly downtime with app-guided inspections that anyone can follow. The iXX-Series allows users to capture thermal images with accurate Delta T measurements, compare the data to baseline readings, and detect changes before they become failures. With automatic uploads to our FLIR apps, Assetlink™ and Ignite™, you can track asset trends, generate work orders, and integrate results with your Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS)—without ever leaving the field. 
Industry-Specific Problem Solving 
Enabled on camera through the Apps feature, iXX-Series cameras offer a range of FLIR-built and 3rd party apps that open up a world of possibilities in terms of problem solving. Explore the apps created by our developer partners to see how they can solve your problems, load an existing app you use every day, or connect with FLIR to tailor-make one of your own. Whether used for infrared inspections or specialized industrial applications, the iXX-Series provides flexibility for every inspection scenario. 
 View Apps 
Safe Electrical Inspection 
When using an infrared camera for maintenance inspections, safety is non-negotiable. The Flir iXX-Series helps you reduce safety risks and improve decision-making with high-resolution thermal imaging, glove-friendly controls, and wide fields of view—ideal for inspecting energized equipment through IR windows. Use the Meterlink® app to capture load, voltage, and other electrical measurements alongside thermal data, giving you the complete context to prioritize repairs and prevent outages. 
Efficient Building Inspections 
Streamline building diagnostics with workflows designed for HVAC performance checks, water damage assessment, and energy loss surveys. On-camera routing ensures consistency across inspections, while instant fault analysis helps you make confident recommendations on-site. Data is securely transferred to your cloud or building management system, so reports and insights are ready to share before you leave the job.
